description: This file defines the 'Modification' class within the OpenCart system, specifically in the Catalog Controller Event namespace. The class extends a system Controller and provides methods for handling various aspects of modifications, including controller, model, view, and library components, with functions to re-route or adjust file paths for extension-based modifications.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling modifications within the catalog event namespace, providing methods to resolve controller, model, view, and library file paths for extension modifications.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Adjusts the $route parameter if the corresponding controller file exists within a specific extension directory, adding the 'extension/ocmod/' prefix when appropriate.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Resolves the correct file path for models, automatically inserting 'extension/ocmod/' prefix if the file exists within the extension directory structure, based on the route.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Adjusts the $route for view templates within the extension directory if the file exists, particularly for Twig templates in the admin view directory.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Resolves the correct file path for libraries, prefixing 'extension/ocmod/' if the file is found in system library directories.
